description: dry-run validate a joseki knowledge-base card that the calling agent authored by value — card identity, contract sections, step sequence — returning every hard-fail error and soft warning without storing anything.
embedding_description: Validate an agent-authored joseki card before it is registered. Non-mutating dry run over the reusable pattern card: JOSEKI_KEY identity, description pair, input and output contract sections, expected step count, next and repair references, and live process keys in the step sequence. Returns errors and warnings; stores nothing.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Validation report with keys: valid, errors, warnings, joseki_key
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Present valid first, then every entry of errors and warnings verbatim — the caller needs the full list to repair the card in one pass.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: If valid is true, the card can be registered. If valid is false, repair the listed errors in the authored card and validate again; warnings are advisory and do not block registration.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dry-run validating an agent-authored joseki knowledge-base card. validate_authored_joseki accepts {content, joseki_key?}. The card is passed by value; nothing is stored.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema (note: card findings are returned in the result's errors list, not raised). ServiceUnavailable: the process discovery service is not available, so live process-key existence could not be checked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Argument-shape failures: fix the action arguments and resubmit. Discovery unavailability: retry after the platform finishes starting; do not treat it as a card error.
